name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Gnome, Greataxe, and Illusion belong to different adventurers.
Exactly one of these is true: Fenwick goes with Cleric; Mara goes with Ranger; Dragonborn goes with Longsword.
Between Dragonborn and Half-Orc, one goes with Greataxe and the other with Longsword.
Half-Orc goes with at least two of Mara, Druid, and Rapier.
Half-Orc goes with neither Fenwick nor Evocation.
Rapier goes with exactly two of Fenwick, Ranger, and Illusion.
